tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List active projects in the workspace.

tools.name: get_work_item
tools.description: Fetch one work item by id.

tools.name: create_work_item
tools.description: File a work item under a project (project_id) or phase (phase_id). Set include_playwright_verification:true to require a browser/visual check before shipping.

tools.name: update_work_item
tools.description: Edit a work item's title/body/kind/priority/status, or toggle include_playwright_verification.

tools.name: assign_workitem_to_branch
tools.description: Associate a work item with a git branch name.

tools.name: post_thread_message
tools.description: Post a message to a work item's discussion thread.

tools.name: create_todo
tools.description: Create a todo (optionally on a work_item_id/project_id).

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Write a durable project memory (kind: fact/decision/gotcha/convention/preference). Pass project_slug to scope it. Lands as an agent-authored entry for the operator to review.

tools.name: recall
tools.description: Read active project memories (optionally filter by project_slug / kind). Bumps recall counts.

tools.name: forget
tools.description: Archive a memory by id (soft delete).

tools.name: log_playwright_verification
tools.description: Record a BROWSER/VISUAL verification on a work item, with screenshots. Use after driving the running app in a Playwright browser to confirm a visual change renders. Pass work_item_ref, a pass/fail status, and screenshots = ABSOLUTE FILE PATHS of the PNG/JPEG/WebP images (the server reads them off disk and uploads them — never paste image data). Lands as a playwright_verification activity on the WI timeline. This is the ONLY way to create that activity; log_activity can't carry images.
